coding.display: Permanent maxillary left central incisor tooth

component.valueString: Building pain over approximately 3 days; now unable to chew or bite with the front teeth.
Sharp pain when biting on the front teeth.
Sensitive to cold; lingering discomfort after the stimulus is removed.
Aches without anything touching it, including at rest.

note.text: Symptom findings captured as discrete components during Dr. Webb's structured virtual assessment. The finding is correlated to tooth #9 both directly (Observation.bodySite) and to the patient-submitted intraoral photos (Observation.derivedFrom -> the two ARex content entries DocumentReference/arex-entry-photo-1 and -2, listed in List/arex-manifest-intraoral-photos). This derivedFrom link is the R4 work-around for the affected tooth: R4 DocumentReference has no bodySite element, so the tooth is carried on this coded Observation, letting the receiving PMS re-associate the photos to tooth #9. No LOINC code is asserted for the overall symptom finding (text-only components, per project verification discipline).
